# Hidden sequence controls

Original OOXML generated by `tools/sequence_hidden_fixture.py` using only Python's
standard library. Each field intentionally starts with a stale cached result.
Opening preserves that cache; explicit F9 refresh recalculates it.

`hidden.docx` exercises increment, hidden increment, repeat and reset: the
expected paragraph results are `1`, empty, `3`, empty, `4`, empty, `11`.
`formatted.docx` exercises `\h \* roman` and `\* MERGEFORMAT \h`: expected
results are `1`, `ii`, `3`, `4`. The general switch overrides hiding in both
orders. Semantics follow ECMA-376 Part 1 §17.16.5.56, printed pp.1241–1243.

Browser controls check the actual F9 command, one-step undo, unchanged original
parts after undo, updated DOCX export/reopen and idempotent refresh. These are
field-semantics controls, not native layout references.
